description: Use to screen general IRS payment and collection alternatives from a rough balance, filing-compliance status, ability-to-pay category, and coarse tax-account type when known. This is an educational fit screen, not a promise that the IRS will approve an option.

ability_to_pay.description: Your realistic ability to pay. can_pay_in_full_soon = you can clear the balance within 180 days; can_make_monthly_payments = a monthly amount but not in full; can_pay_little = only a very small monthly amount; cannot_pay_basic_living = paying the IRS would leave you unable to cover basic living expenses (financial hardship).

all_required_returns_filed.description: Whether every required tax return has actually been FILED (even if the tax was not paid). Filing compliance is generally required before the IRS formalizes a collection alternative, but the exact account requirements control. Defaults to false.

balance_includes_penalties.description: Whether the balance includes failure-to-file or failure-to-pay penalties, so penalty abatement may reduce it. Defaults to true.

balance_owed_usd.description: Total amount owed to the IRS including tax, penalties, and interest (a rough figure is fine).

brief.description: Set true for a shorter answer: options come back as path + fit only, without the descriptions.

tax_account_type.description: Coarse, nonidentifying IRS account type. individual_income_tax includes Form 1040 income-tax balances, including a sole proprietor whose balance is on Form 1040. business_non_trust_fund_or_out_of_business covers non-trust-fund business tax or an out-of-business sole proprietor account. business_trust_fund covers in-business payroll or other trust-fund tax. Use unknown when unsure. Defaults to unknown.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: Official IRS or FinCEN authority to review before relying on the result.
